_comment: TEMPLATE. Copy to editions.local.json in the repo root and edit. That file is
gitignored, so your own domains never collide with an upstream merge - the same
WHAT THIS IS FOR: hosting this site on your own domain WITHOUT maintaining a
fork. lib/editions.js is the tracked registry of Dermot's own domains; this
file adds yours, or re-points an existing edition, without editing a tracked
engine file and re-resolving a conflict every time you pull upstream.
An entry whose `id` matches one in lib/editions.js OVERRIDES it, field by
field. A new `id` is added alongside. `domains` is what scripts/cpanel-deploy.sh
matches on, so a bare host is enough - scheme, www., port and path are ignored.
WHAT YOU CANNOT DO HERE, BY DESIGN: add story content. There is no field for a
lore page, a chapter, or a glossary entry, because canon is centralised and
every per-domain variation is non-canonical. That protects you as much as the
record: nothing you put in this file can be mistaken for this story's canon.
Story content stays CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (see CONTENT-LICENSE.md); the engine is MIT.
Remove this _comment key or leave it - it is ignored either way.

editions.label: My Star Rangers mirror
editions.heroSubtitle: Your own front-of-house line. Plain HTML is allowed here; inline links must be absolute paths under /star-rangers/ and must resolve, or scripts/check-internal-links.js will say so.
